tagline: Your Linux. Your rules. AI-ready when you choose.
claimsPolicy: Only editions with releaseStatus=developer-preview have official downloadable images; planned features are not shipped.

editions.name: KINGAI OS Desktop
editions.target: Personal computing, developers and optional local AI tools
editions.notes: Developer preview; not certified for primary workstations.

editions.name: KINGAI OS Server
editions.target: Headless Linux servers, VMs, containers and user-selected agent runtimes
editions.notes: Development server preview; not certified for production.

editions.name: KINGAI OS Edge
editions.target: Small-footprint managed appliances, gateways and offline-first edge nodes
editions.notes: Not released. No hardware, OTA, fleet management or ARM64 support is claimed.

editions.name: KINGAI OS AI Workstation
editions.target: User-controlled local model development and GPU-enabled AI workflows
editions.notes: Not released. GPU/driver support and preinstalled model runtimes are not claimed.

policies.privacy: No mandatory KINGAI account, bundled agents, models or hidden telemetry are advertised for current previews.
policies.security: Hash comparison is not a signature or proof of secure build.
policies.release: No planned edition may be displayed as downloadable or stable without real signed artifact and validation evidence.
